text.en:
The City of Davao is hereby authorized to pay Santiago Artiaga, City Mayor, the sum of eight
hundred twenty-two pesos and fifty-nine centavos, corresponding to his salary from January twelve to
February twenty-eight, nineteen hundred and thirty-seven; and also to Jose Elayda, City Treasurer, the sum of
four hundred and fifty pesos, corresponding to his salary from January sixteen to February twenty-eight,
nineteen hundred and thirty-seven.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 9, 1938.
